name: Yuki no Kanata
source:
Hero was adopted by Takamori family at the age of 15 and he has no memory of previous years. Now he returns there after two years of absence and finds a lot of sisters-in-law. He also meets a girl with magic and gets involved in affairs of a mysterious organization. What is the mystery behind hero's past?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公15岁时被高森家收养，对此前的岁月却毫无记忆。离开两年后，他如今再度回到高森家，并发现自己多出了许多没有血缘关系的姐妹。他还遇见一名拥有魔法的少女，因此被卷入一个神秘组织的纷争。主人公失去的过去，究竟隐藏着怎样的秘密？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
